note: Literature and OMIM records confirm that heterozygous loss-of-function variants in SPTAN1 causing autosomal dominant dHMN11 exhibit incomplete penetrance.

evidence.text: Heterozygous nonsense mutations in SPTAN1 causing autosomal dominant distal hereditary motor neuropathy demonstrate variable and incomplete penetrance across families, including documented asymptomatic mutation carriers.
